properties.name: Etruscan Afterlife Banquet
properties.summary: Etruscan tomb paintings depict joyful afterlife banquets where the deceased feast, dance, and enjoy music in the presence of guardian spirits. Vanth, a winged female figure, guided souls. Charun, with his hammer, guarded the underworld gate. The Etruscans viewed death as a transition to continued celebration.

properties.name: Tages Rises from the Furrow
properties.summary: While plowing a field near Tarquinia, a farmer's plow uncovered a child with the wisdom of an elder. This was Tages, a divine being who taught the Etruscans the art of haruspicy (reading entrails), the interpretation of lightning, and the sacred laws (Etrusca disciplina). He then vanished.
